answer: Rhythm-Gated Arrival Windows. Each identity must route its first N actions through a random delay chosen from a private schedule, like a dune shifting under wind, so genuine agents arrive in irregular bursts. A walnut-sized quota of pre-paid relay tickets, spent one per burst, enforces it. Clustering arrivals inside a fixed window collapses the schedule and flags the cluster; the garden of established identities ignores flagged newcomers.
